title: Mixed scalar compatibility for the specified compact-support exchange
statement: For any Cartesian square h:X′→X, f′:X′→Y′, f:X→Y and g:Y′→Y, a compactification c of f, finite commutative rings A and B, a homomorphism φ:A→B and an arbitrary derived A-module M on X, the coefficient comparison b [def-sp-reduction-direct-image-comparison], the specified compact-support exchange beta [def-sp-mixed-base-change-operations], the canonical tensor/pullback maps lambda [def-sp-constant-scalar-pullback-comparison], and scalar extension S [det-sp-scalar-extension-functor] satisfy lambda_Y(F_A M)^{-1} g_B^*(b(M)) beta_B(S_X M) = S_Y′(beta_A(M)) b′(h_A^*M) F_B′(lambda_X(M)^{-1}). This is only the direct-image part of mixed base change: there are no exceptional adjoints or constructible-input conclusions.

source.place: Direct-image proof, Steps 1--5: proper/open pasting before inverse scalar comparisons

proof.text: Expand b as chi followed by proper pushforward of the open tensor map, and beta as proper exchange followed by proper pushforward of transported ordinary open exchange. Naturality moves the open tensor map across proper exchange.

The ordinary/intrinsic realization equivalences preserve the sectionwise open units. Thus the transported ordinary open exchange and the canonical open-adjunction mate have equal transposes and are equal. Conjugate openScalarExchange by reductionOpenModel and push its equality through the proper direct image.

Apply directImageScalarExchange to the proper Cartesian square at j_A!M. Naturality of chi at the open exchange finishes the four-arrow pasting; associativity yields the stated forward mixed square. Precompose the forward identity with the inverse target scalar/pullback comparison and postcompose with the inverse source comparison. Associativity and the inverse identities give the displayed inverse-comparison form.

lean.statement:
theorem mixedCompactSupportScalar
    {X' X Y' Y : Scheme.{u}} {g' : X' ⟶ X} {f' : X' ⟶ Y'}
    {f : X ⟶ Y} {g : Y' ⟶ Y} (sq : ChosenCartesianSquare g' f' f g)
    (cpt : Compactification f)
    {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Finite A] [Finite B]
    (φ : A →+* B) (M : proEtaleDerivedCategory X A) :
    (directImageScalarPullbackIso φ g).inv.app
        ((reductionCompactSupport A cpt.i cpt.g).obj M) ≫
      (proEtaleConstantRingDerivedPullback B g).map
        ((reductionDirectImageComparison φ cpt.i cpt.g).app M) ≫
      (mixedCompactSupportExchange B sq cpt).app
        ((scalarExtensionFunctor φ X).obj M) =
    (scalarExtensionFunctor φ Y').map ((mixedCompactSupportExchange A sq cpt).app M) ≫
      (reductionDirectImageComparison φ (mixedPullbackCompactification sq cpt).i
        (mixedPullbackCompactification sq cpt).g).app
          ((proEtaleConstantRingDerivedPullback A g').obj M) ≫
      (reductionCompactSupport B (mixedPullbackCompactification sq cpt).i
        (mixedPullbackCompactification sq cpt).g).map
          ((directImageScalarPullbackIso φ g').inv.app M)
